title: Warehouse Receiving Checklist
subtitle: Warehouse Receiving: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Warehouse Receiving Checklist covers inbound appointment, vehicle, seal, handling unit, item, lot, quantity, and putaway status. The receiving operations coordinator records Warehouse Receiving criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Warehouse Receiving Checklist keeps Warehouse Receiving exceptions visible until the receiving operations coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Warehouse Receiving Checklist at gate, yard, receiving dock, staging lane, inspection area, and storage location. Document inbound appointment, vehicle, seal, handling unit, item, lot, quantity, and putaway status identity before Warehouse Receiving begins. Compare inbound appointment, vehicle, seal, handling unit, item, lot, quantity, and putaway status findings with stated Warehouse Receiving criteria; route unresolved Warehouse Receiving issues to warehouse inventory reviewer. For Warehouse Receiving Checklist, confirm requirements for Warehouse Receiving. Ask warehouse inventory reviewer to review Warehouse Receiving conditions beyond the receiving operations coordinator's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Warehouse Receiving, identify responsible parties, gate, yard, receiving dock, staging lane, inspection area, and storage location, and the linked inbound appointment, vehicle, seal, handling unit, item, lot, quantity, and putaway status source.

fields.label: Appointment, purchase order, shipment, and receipt
Carrier, driver, vehicle, trailer, and seal
Item, lot, serial, pallet, quantity, and unit

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Warehouse Receiving facts for inbound appointment, vehicle, seal, handling unit, item, lot, quantity, and putaway status; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Warehouse Receiving inspection checks
items: Arrival, gate, dock, and unload timing
Quarantine, hold, cross-dock, or accepted status
Receipt posting, label, staging, and putaway

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Before closing Warehouse Receiving, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Receiving Operations Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Seal, identity, quantity, or condition mismatch
Receipt posting or putaway cannot be reconciled
blocks.guidance: Pause Warehouse Receiving when arrival authority, seal, identity, condition, quantity, system receipt, or storage destination remains unresolved. Retain the available Warehouse Receiving proof and route unresolved inbound appointment, vehicle, seal, handling unit, item, lot, quantity, and putaway status scope to receiving operations coordinator.
